name: The Ketos AP
description: A shadow the size of an island appears in the water beneath the ship.
disable: DC 27 Acrobatics , DC 27 Athletics , or DC 27 Diplomacy or Sailing Lore|dc:23 to help the crew of the Tide Hunter escape the Ketos; three total successes are required to disable the hazard
reset: If three or more of its tentacles are destroyed, the Ketos releases the Tide Hunter and disappears into the ocean's depths to nurse its wounds. The monster does not return to this area for 24 hours.
routine: (3 actions) The Ketos uses its actions to make tentacle Strikes against creatures aboard the Tide Hunter or within 30 feet of the ship.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grasp of the Depths
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The Tide Hunter enters the Ketos's hunting grounds

Effect The Ketos uses its eight tentacles to seize the ship, holding it in place. The hazard then rolls initiative.
